payload.title: Bind response/stream delivery, replay and cancellation to one Frank execution generation
payload.work_clay: Extend the production token-API execution contract so durable request admission is followed by provenance-bound response lifecycle state: RESPONSE_STARTED, monotonically identified chunks or atomic response body receipt, terminal response, delivery/replay cursor, cancellation, disconnect and release/handoff. Bind every emit/chunk/terminal operation to the current V15/V16 execution generation and apply a final pre-emit fence. After restart, an admitted request must not execute twice; if a complete response was durably produced it must be replayable to the authenticated same scoped request/client without rerunning cognition/effects. A partial response must have an explicit resume-or-restart policy that cannot splice chunks across generations. BUSY remains privacy-preserving and token authentication remains credential/scope, never SELF.
payload.reason_clay: Current V16 execution continuity provides durable request idempotency and duplicate-execution prevention, while the current replay body explicitly reports response_replay_available=false. A production token API therefore still lacks a complete crash/reconnect delivery contract even when request admission is exactly-once. HTTP transport implementation should not precede this lifecycle contract because automatic release after a POST can break same-session continuation and release before final emission conflicts with generation fencing.
payload.completion_clay: Target-compatible integration test covers: valid authenticated request -> response start -> chunks/terminal -> final pre-emit generation fence -> release/handoff; duplicate same request after restart returns stored terminal response without re-execution; partial-stream crash has explicit bounded resume/restart behavior; stale generation cannot emit any later chunk or terminal record; cancellation is idempotent and provenance-bound; disconnect never silently marks DONE; BUSY leaks no holder/session/location; exact raw response/chunk hashes and resource/latency rows are preserved; no current effect path is duplicated; target-VPS receipt binds exact source/runtime/schema hashes.
invalidators: A newer current-main target receipt already proves durable response replay/partial-stream recovery with generation fencing
The production API contract is owner-fixed to a non-streaming atomic response surface and an equivalent durable response receipt already exists
